issue.title: 4.4: Parallelize MapView cache reads and URL scan
issue.body_excerpt: Promise.all for getGeoCache; hostname Map for detectPlatformFromUrl.

affected_files.role: primary - loadGeoData() loop (line 58-63) does `for (const domain of uniqueDomains) { const cached = await getGeoCache(domain); ... }` — serial awaits. Replace with `const cachedArr = await Promise.all(uniqueDomains.map(d => getGeoCache(d)));` then build geoMap from the array. Acceptance: `rg -n 'await getGeoCache' src/dashboard/components/MapView.jsx` exits 1 (no await inside the loop).

primary - detectPlatformFromUrl (line ~35) iterates the DOMAIN_TO_PLATFORM_MAP with `for (const domain in DOMAIN_TO_PLATFORM_MAP) { if (url.includes(domain)) ... }` — O(catalog * url_length) per call. The catalog is ~400+ domain strings across 50 platforms. The acceptance says 'hostname Map' — restructure the lookup to: extract `new URL(url).hostname` once, then check an O(1) Map keyed by hostname (or a Map<string, string> keyed by every host that appears in TRACKING_PLATFORMS[*].domains). Note: many catalog entries are not full hostnames (e.g. 'facebook.com/tr' contains a path). The cleanest split: keep DOMAIN_TO_PLATFORM_MAP as-is for path-aware matches AND add a HOSTNAME_TO_PLATFORM Map for exact-host matches. The hostname check is O(1); the path-aware fallback remains O(catalog) but is now a second pass, not the primary.

secondary - already a pure data module. May need to add a helper that exports both the existing TRACKING_PLATFORMS and a new HOSTNAME_TO_PLATFORM Map (or a helper `buildHostnameMap(TRACKING_PLATFORMS)`) so pixel-detector can use it without re-implementing the build. Trivial change.

analysis.current_implementation: MapView.jsx:58-63 runs `await getGeoCache(domain)` inside a `for...of` loop, serialising N independent reads (each an IndexedDB GET, ~1-5ms each on a cold DB; on a 10k-footprint dashboard with ~50 unique domains this is up to ~250ms of wasted serial time). pixel-detector.js:35-46 (detectPlatformFromUrl) iterates an object-map with `for...in` and calls `url.includes(domain)` for every catalog entry — O(M*N) per URL, M = catalog size (~400 strings), N = url length.
analysis.limitations: Map geolocation load is unnecessarily slow; the platform-detection path has two inefficiencies (O(N) per call and string `includes` which is the worst of both worlds). The detection path is also the content-script's hot loop (called for every script tag, every img, every iframe, every mutation — so it compounds).
analysis.change_surface: 3 files. MapView.jsx is a 5-line change (Promise.all + reduce). pixel-detector.js is a 5-10 line change (extract hostname once, look up in Map, fall back to DOMAIN_TO_PLATFORM_MAP for path-aware matches). tracking-platforms.js is a small data addition (HOSTNAME_TO_PLATFORM Map, derived once at module load). Verify: `rg -n 'await getGeoCache' src/dashboard/components/MapView.jsx` exits 1; `rg -n "for \(const domain in DOMAIN_TO_PLATFORM_MAP\)" src/lib/pixel-detector.js` exits 1.
analysis.root_cause: MapView serialises independent DB reads; detectPlatformFromUrl uses a linear scan with a substring search instead of a hostname-keyed Map. Both are F-PERF-004/006 (perf) and the host lookup also touches F-BUG-008 (correctness: a domain like 'notgoogle.com' includes 'google.com' substrings? No — it doesn't, but a url like 'evilgoogle.com' would falsely match. The hostname check eliminates this class of bug for exact host matches.)

options.name: Promise.all + hostname Map
options.summary: MapView.loadGeoData: `const pairs = await Promise.all(uniqueDomains.map(async d => [d, await getGeoCache(d)])); const geoMap = Object.fromEntries(pairs.filter(([, c]) => c && c.lat && c.lon));` (or build it imperatively). pixel-detector: precompute HOSTNAME_TO_PLATFORM from TRACKING_PLATFORMS[*].domains filtered to entries without '/' (i.e. plain hostnames). detectPlatformFromUrl: try `new URL(url).hostname` and look up directly; on miss or on path-bearing catalog entries, fall back to the existing substring pass.
pros: Parallel DB reads cut load time by N (small N but real)
Hostname Map is O(1) and fixes F-BUG-008 (substring false-positives on path-bearing hosts)
Backward compatible: substring fallback preserved for non-hostname entries
cons: URL constructor throws on malformed URLs — needs a try/catch fallback to the existing substring pass
options.risk_details: Tiny, well-isolated changes. The behavior on legitimate detection paths is unchanged; the only delta is speed and the elimination of a small class of false matches.

decision_record.root_cause: MapView serialises independent IndexedDB GETs in a for/await loop; detectPlatformFromUrl linearly scans ~400 catalog entries with a substring match per URL.
decision_record.residual_risk: URL constructor can throw on malformed inputs — wrap in try/catch and fall back to existing substring pass. Hostname Map only covers catalog entries that look like hostnames (no '/'); path-bearing entries keep the substring fallback. Verify `rg -n 'await getGeoCache' src/dashboard/components/MapView.jsx` exits 1 after.
